description.value:
The Flesh Shaper drew the threshold's cold light into this one, and a thread of it never left. The dark took a name in payment, and the world half-forgot the bearer to seal the bargain.

Wrapped in cold light (the gift). You gain resistance 10 to cold, permanently — it blunts the Queen of Shadows' rime in the finale, and any cold that comes after.

Voice of the gulf. 2 (once per day) You loose the despair of the lightless plane, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wave of Despair]{Wave of Despair} as an innate spell (a 30-foot cone, Will save). Use a spell DC appropriate to your level — your own spell DC if you have one, otherwise the standard innate DC for a creature of your level. (Tracked by hand: once per day.)

The name given to the dark (the cost). You surrendered your name to the gulf, and the world half-forgets you: allies grope for what to call you, and you take a −2 status penalty to Diplomacy — until you win the name back.
